SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.
   C. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   D. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   B. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

6. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.

   C. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   D. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
   D. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   C. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   C. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat School administration as rumours only.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

13. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)

   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

15. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
